hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: fail_empty_stacks
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Fail the swap if either stack resolves to no HTTPD instances. Keep true for established environments so a no-op swap cannot flip the state file.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # Fail fast: a swap that silently moves nothing must fail the build so the # calling pipeline does not go on to flip the deployment state file. set -eo pipefail
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" ls -la "$source_scripts_folder"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done
# assume_role exports empty creds on STS failure instead of returning non-zero; # verify we actually got credentials before touching target groups. assume_role if [ -z "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" ]; then echo "ERROR: assume_role did not produce credentials; aborting swap." >&2 exit 1 fi
# Target group names come from injected global config; without them swap_stacks # would look up empty ARNs and skip every leg while still reporting success. if [ -z "${staging_tg_name:-}" ] || [ -z "${live_tg_name:-}" ]; then echo "ERROR: staging_tg_name and live_tg_name must both be set." >&2 exit 1 fi
# Command to execute swap_stacks. The 5th arg makes an empty stack fatal. swap_stacks "${staging_tg_name}" \ "${live_tg_name}" \ "${WORKSPACE}/staging_httpd_tags_file.json" \ "${WORKSPACE}/live_httpd_tags_file.json" \ "${fail_empty_stacks:-true}"
